name: ck-code
description: Spec-driven workflow plugin: design -> plan -> build -> ship. Transforms specs into architecture docs, epics/stories, and auto-generated expert and language-guide skills tailored to your tech stack. Story state lives in frontmatter; indexes are generated.

model_fast.title: Fast tier model
model_fast.description: Model alias dispatched for trivial mechanical stories and QA command runs.

model_balanced.title: Balanced tier model
model_balanced.description: Default model alias for a story implementer in /ck-code:build PARALLEL MODE.

model_advanced.title: Advanced tier model
model_advanced.description: Model alias for stories with a high-reasoning signal — novel algorithm, concurrency correctness, security- or perf-critical path.

guards.title: Mod guards
guards.description: Refuse hand edits of generated views (STORIES_INDEX.md, EPICS_INDEX.md) and git clean -x/-X in a ck-code project.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the active story, the story counts and the recommended next command above the prompt.

pr_watch.title: Merged-PR watch
pr_watch.description: Check your merged GitHub PRs every 5 minutes and say when the plan has not recorded one yet.
